balls.text: full toss on middle and off, Hodge swipes a one-handed four to long leg to push Royals to 189! Rohit has a wry smile. Hussey is jogging off to get ready for the reply. Remember Mumbai need to hunt this down in 87 balls. That's a required rate of 13.2 over

this was a slower bouncer, he had to drag it from outside off and that means he doesn't get enough power to beat deep midwicket. Easy catch, but the umpires are asking him to stay back. They want to check the height on this, remember Pollard had bowled a bouncer earlier. This would be a no-ball if it is over shoulder-height. It looks very tight, but the third umpire says it's okay
goes for a bouncer and it's got a little too much height on it. Excellent presence of mind from Faulkner to pull away from his stroke
full and angled in, Hodge skews it to long-on
length ball, slower ball, in the slot and Hodge set himself up, waited with a giant backlift and clattered it into the sight screen

that is spectacularly done! It was length and it was hacked away wide of long-on. Anderson hustled from deep midwicket. reached out and plucked the ball from beyond the boundary, while keeping his feet in play and pulls it back inside
drilled down the ground and some urgency between the wickets fetches two. Pollard finds the blockhole, more or less
and add six more! This time the low full toss is launched over deep midwicket. Powerful hit from Faulkner
flicks a low full toss to deep midwicket. That's only the sixth run off the over
full toss on middle, Faulkner has swiped it to deep midwicket. Would be disappointed he didn't put that away
this time he fires in a full toss down the leg side.
another one, this time Hodge spoons it back to the bowler who misfields. But it is only a single. Third yorker on the trot from Bumrah
has to shovel another yorker from off stump into the covers. Two very useful balls at this stage
starts off well with a yorker on middle and off. Dug out into the off side for a single
keeps to a good length on off stump, Hodge retains strike with a single through to the sweeper
short and wide, Hodge rocked back and cut away with considerable skill. It seemed to skid off the deck, but Hodge used that pace so well
seeks the blockhole and Faulkner pushes down the ground
tries to foil the plot by looping it outside off, but Faulkner has reached out and sent it into orbit over midwicket. Grudging glance as the ball sails away from Rohit
but the follow up is poor. This was full and flat and in the arc for Faulkner to slog sweep over square leg
that's more like it. This was much slower and the top spinner gets more bounce to fool Faulkner's attempted sweep
that was the arm ball and Hodge lunged forward to block. Only two runs off that over
short and a touch wide, Hodge cannot put it away as his cut finds point
tossed up on middle, drilled to long-on
prefers to stay back and cut this shortish ball into the covers
that might just have stayed a touch low judging from Faulkner's reaction. It was a touch short and skidded into the keeper as the batsman tried to cut
nice and slow just outside off, Hodge has to wait a long time before steering it to short third man
goes short and Hodge has little problem cutting through point
flighted outside off, driven down the ground to long-off

lashed over the covers and it needed a brilliant effort from Rayudu to stop it from reaching the boundary. Used the flight and did not hold back. The sweeper hurtled to his left and dived to parry the ball, but even as he pleaded for support there was no one coming to his aid. He has to get up and get the ball in himself
he's sliced it and the outside edge lands safely in the hands of a backtracking Bhajji at point. That's a useful double-strike and are Mumbai back in this? Lovely flight from Gopal that time
stays back and cuts the shortish ball through to the sweeper
tossed up outside off, Samson taps it through extra cover

and almost predictably it has to end with a soft dismissal. Took a while to register considering Mumai weren't too keep on celebrating. The bowler was only concerned to see if it carried and then turned away with a bowed head. It was short and Nair goes for the pull. But he's mistimed it this time and Simmons at short midwicket picks up a good, low chance.
slower ball pushed full and outside off, Samson walks across outside off and tickles into midwicket for the single that brings them a hundred partnership
offers up a full toss on middle, Samson has carved it over point. Simple stroke, excellently executed
walks across and whips the full length ball to deep square leg
goes for a seam up delivery and Samson has punched it through point. Deep third man needed a desperate drive to pull things back
attempts the slower ball but Samson almost seemed to read his mind. Waited on the back foot and lets it run off the open face to collect a very clever boundary to third man
switches around the wicket, no change in pace though. Still quick and flat. Pushes down the ground to long-on
they are turning it on here! Bhajji goes short on middle, Samson jumps back and mauls it over wide long-on
nudged through midwicket. Such a nonchalant shot to bring up a neat little fifty
lobbed over short fine leg. Bumrah attempts a feeble attempt to catch it but it sailed over his head. Excellent scoop-pull from Nair and Bhajji has started bowling quick and flat
it was just a little short and Samson made it shorter with some lovely footwork. Goes back and outside leg to carve it over extra cover. Simmons is quick enough at long-off thoguh
set up for the reverse sweep early which allowed Bhajji to shorten his length. Samson adjusts and directs it through point

reverse chop! Nair is doiing something special here! That's the time out. It was fired in as Ojha switched his angle to over the wicket. Nair's balance is almost perfect and beats short third man comfortably
another shortish ball, but it was a little closer to off stump. Mistimes the chop into the covers
exhibits range now as he opens up his stance and cuts through point. Such quick hands. Another short ball dispatched
that's been massacred! Another poor ball as Ojha bowls short and wide outside off. Nair goes deep in his crease and pulls way into the crowd at midwicket
wanders outside leg stump and when the bowler follows him, he tucks it to short fine leg for the single that gets him to a fifty
gripped on the pitch, but since it was short the batsman had time to gauge it and flick through midwicket
threatened to walk across to the off side, and when Pollard fired a length ball down the leg side, he has just swiped it over the head of short fine leg. Brilliant work
they're starting to pick the gaps here. Goes short with the change of pace and Samson waited just enough before pulling between deep square leg and deep midwikcet
full on middle, worked away to long-on
goes the slower bouncer way, 118 kph, Nair backed away to upper cut it. But misses. Third man was inside too
carved over cover. Why would they fiddle with Nair's batting position when he is in such good form. This was full and had enough room outside off to be lifted for a one-bounce four
doesn't bother with any pace on the ball. Samson has to wait ages before pushing down to long-on
that is spectacular! Full and on the pads and Nair responds with a punch. It had no follow through, yet the strength of his bottom hand has sent the ball skimming to the midwicket boundary.
goes for the reverse sweep and gets the smallest connection to beat the keeper to dribble away to the third man boundary
held it back just a touch and Nair steps forward to block. Takes a bit of a leading edge into the off side
split the gap between deep midwicket and long-on as Gopal goes short and flat. He was waiting for it and thought he didn't time it as well as the last shot.
and another one! Gopal seems to be the one that's got to go. This was flighted right where Nair wanted it and launches him over deep midwicket. Slog sweep paying dividends again
stopped on him as he was looking to knock it away into the leg side. The ball goes in the air, but is well beyond the bowler's reach
took it from way outside off stump and pulls it to deep midwicket. Struck it reasonably well too
slower ball with a bit of width, Nair has to made the pace as he cuts towards point
fullish and outside off, driven into the covers. Looks quite correct, this fellow
full and into the pads, Samson clips it behind square leg
wore this short ball on the stomach. Another short ball with no pace on it and this pitch is aiding those efforts
he backtracks on and on as fast as he could, but the ball lobs over his head. Bumrah could have made a better effort. This was a slower short ball and resulted in a thick top edge
tossed up on off stump, defended with an open face
picked out the flighted on and mauled it over square leg. Slog sweep with such immense power.
flighted and drifting in on leg, flicked through midwicket
we have a direct hit from third man and the third umpire gets some work. Although the excitement is all for nothing as Nair was in safely
went back in his crease and finds it wasn't as short as he thought. Adjusts from his pull to a short armed jab to midwicket
keeps nice and tight on middle, punched down to long-on
pushed down to long-on as he holds his length back and that brings us to a time-out. Will Royals come out of it with a bit more intent?
attempted to make some room to scythe the tossed up delivery over extra cover, but the ball straightens instead of spinning in. Beats him
goes for a reverse sweep and it has been placed well enough to collect a quick couple.
flighted outside off, driven to long-off. With every ball bowled, Faulkner and Hodge's job is getting tougher
slower through the air and it doesn't turn as Nair expects. Dabbed down the pitch
pushed down to long-on as he goes deep in the crease
steps down and there is a little bit of hesitation after he pushes into the covers. Not bad enough to stop the single from being taken
flighted on middle, Nair employs a shot that has been highly productive for him. Swept to deep square leg
steps forward and times a push towards mid-off rather nicely
loopy delivery on middle, Nair pushes back to the bowler
goes back and flicks it through midwikcet.
flighted on middle, Samson stays beside it and blocks with an open face
saw the batsman moving around in the crease and pushed it full and flat. Samson bunts it down to long-on
flighted on middle, Samson comes forward to block
keeps it slow and around off stump, Nair goes back and blocks

this is slower and it's a little more tossed up. Watson came down the track and skewed the loft. Pollard raced in and dived forward to take a good, low catch. Explodes in a Guitar Hero-like celebration. Wankhede  breaks the sound barrier
another flatter one, seemed to be the topspinner. Watson went back to pull but the extra bounce is too much for him
starts off with a terrible delivery. Short ball pushed down leg and Watson sweep-pulls it well fine of square leg. Loads of power in that
worked off the pads towards the region of square leg
backs away and punches it through extra  cover. Predictably Ojha went flat and quick
all the way! Samson has always sparkled and this is an effortless sweep that carries beyond the boundary
drifts into middle and leg, Samson looks to nudge it around his front pad
looks to step outside leg and Ojha follows him. Samson wanted that, I think, but his sweep doesn't connect
good length ball on middle, defended
tossed up on middle and leg, Watson eases it through midwicket
and we thought Watson would teach Samson. This full toss is elegantly punched through the covers. Little effort, maximum reward
seeks the yorker and I think it ended up a low full toss. Samson keeps it out
fullish and the width is exploited with a guide to deep third man. That's first runs off Bumrah in nine balls
136kph, this is a full toss on middle, Watson finds mid-on! He'd be sorely disappointed with that
good lenght ball on and around off stump, opens the face to find point
142kph, almost in the slot and Watson looks drill it down the ground. But though the shot looked really good, it doesn't travel off the pitch so quickly
much better this time and he did benefit from enough width and a fuller length to lean into the drive. Sliced between point and third man
almost! Gopal was at short third man and he takes a few paces to his left and pushes out his left hand to try and catch the outside edge of Samson's lashing blade.
directed the good length inswinger on leg stump and Watson is happy to collect a leg bye in front of square leg
Watson lunges on the front foot now and drives into the covers. Anderson flitting between the inswinger and working the angle across the right-hander
invites him on the drive and Samson obliges. Unleashes a straight bat and had to take it on the up, but it seems he hasn't timed it quite as well. Only dribbles down to mid-off
appreciable swing there and the length was quite good too. Cramped him up as he was looking for midwicket. Mild appeal, but it was too high and sliding down leg
144kph, can he really bowl that fast?! This was a fuller one outside off so Watson doesn't bother with it. Looks like he wants to settle before bringing out those booming drives
142kph, solid front foot step to defend this good length ball on off stump. Pollard won't let it go through
141kph, wanted to defend that but prefers to shoulder arms as the back of a length ball skids off the deck
watchfully left alone outside off stump with Bumrah keeping to a fuller length
strides forward to block a full delivery angling into leg stump. Almost had to play around his front pad there. That's Watto's weakness
just back of a length and angled in, as he so often does. Watson allows it through to the keeper
chases at a fuller one angled across him and misses.
good length ball with a bit of width, Samson drives to point and Pollard unleashes a throw to keep the non-striker on his toes
full and wide, Samson might have wanted to glide it away but then thinks better of it
wonderfully timed! Anderson continues getting the ball to dart in, but Samson strides forward and drives with more or less a straight bat to the right of mid-on
better line and that inswing is more threatening. Samson knows it is seeking the base of middle and plays late and pushes to mid-off
strays a little close to his pads and a little bit of nip inward allows Watson to glance it to long leg

it's six, Mumbai have qualified! This was a full toss on leg stump and Tare has launched it over square leg. Tare is beside himself, he pulls his shirt over his head and is being manhandled by his team-mares. Mumbai have exploded all over the Wankhede. Sachin gives big hugs to Anderson and Tare.

it's a ridiculous comedy of error. Rayudu is on his knees on the floor! This was back of a length but a little too quick for him as he went for a cut. Gets struck high on the bat and goes only as far as short cover. They set off for the single and the fielder runs in and underarms a throw to try and get him out but misses. They go for the second and the throw from midwicket finds Rayudu short
it's a full toss on leg stump! That's just about the perfect gift and Rayudu has launched it over the long leg boundary. What a hit! What a collapse under pressure for Faulkner!
shortish and outside off, he wants to keep out of Anderson's swing. Gets a thick edge to deep third man. Only a single
seeks the yorker on off stump, Anderson hacks it down to long-on
he's bisected long-on and midwicket! Who says he struggles against spin! That slog sweep is his safety net and this is a length ball that scurries away. This is awesome power
tossed up outside off, Rayudu remains beside the ball and carves it to deep cover
flighted on middle, Anderson slog sweeps to the man in the deep
that was a tracer bullet if ever there was one. Tambe goes flat and fast, Anderson stays deep in his crease and murders it down the ground
he's missed a full toss! It was in the slot to be massacred over midwicket, but instead its a dot ball
that is brilliant placement! The yorker goes wrong and Rayudu has pulled his front leg away and caressed it through the covers. Too well timed for the man in the deep
this is a short delivery, Anderson goes for a pull but there is protection in the deep

full and wide outside off, Anderson drives wide of long-off. The bat face closes a bit on impact to rid him of the timing. Its a couple and Anderson easily makes it. Third umpire was asked to confirm it and when the big green "Not out" went up on screen, Wankhede roars!
this is short and it is quick, Anderson looks to pull but he is a little too slow on the shot
fullish and on the stumps, Anderson hoicks it down the ground. Was only going to be one but Faulkner lets it through his fingers. Terrible misfield
it is length again and Anderson stands deep in his crease and pummels it too well for long-off to bother with
shortish and outside off, Anderson has cut it over the two men square, but there is also protection in the deep
goes full and wide, he wants to keep it out of Anderson's reach. But he plonks his bat out and gets a thick edge that flies away to third man. This over has changed the game!
goes full on off stump, a little slower this time. Rayudu pushes to long-off
141kph, and another one! This is length on leg stump, Rayudu says thank you very much with a biff that bisects long-on and midwicket
goes short again and Rayudu has backed away and slapped it handsomely over the infield. Just missed going for six
this was the slower short ball and Rayudu has carved it over the short third man fielder. That's not the length to bowl with him up in the circle
well, even the yorker doesn't work! Anderson was waiting outside leg stump and he's sliced it past the reach of hte keeper
picked it up and smoked it over long-on. Anderson is making a strong case here. Faulkner needs to find his yorkers and instead he is going length
swings the fullish delivery from the stumps to deep square leg
shortish delivery well down the leg side.
a little shortish and Anderson flat-bats it down the ground to long-on
room outside off and he carves it through the covers
backs away and smokes it down the ground. Faulkner tried to stop it but it was too well struck. The bowler is on the floor and the ball has pinged into the advertising board
length again and Rayudu has smashed it to the sight screen. Planted his front foot down and swung clean
shortish and on middle, Anderson goes for the pull but its a little too quick for him to time it
launched over long-off! That's his fifty, and he gets to it with a typically powerful stroke down the ground

another full toss with ample room. Anderson whacks it to point and Rayudu has raced to the middle of the pitch! Anderson did not want the single and Ankit Sharma, the fielder, sends in a good throw to the bowler. Kulkarni rushes back and tries to flick the stumps with the back of his hand and misses!
141kph, seeks the wide yorker but this is too far outside off
he's holed out! Rohit had to go for it and it was almost in the slot. Looks to swing as hard as he can, but ends up getting a thick outside edge that sits into the hands of the sweeper
this was the full toss outside off, Rohit flings his bat at it and gets an inside edge that runs away to long leg boundary
goes short and Anderson is too early on the pull. Gets an inside edge back to the bowler
tucked him up just outside off, Anderson bunts it to the right of long-off
launched straight down the ground. The man who turned it all around is being smoked to all parts. It was another length ball and Anderson stood and delivered
fullish and on the pads, Anderson flicks it to deep square leg
long-off gave up. This was a length delivery that allowed Anderson's arms some freedom. Smoked through extra cover
runs down the pitch and lashes this through to deep cover. Got the pitch and drilled it, but doesn't find the gap
little room and Rohit stays beside the ball and slaps it through to the sweeper
loops one on leg, Anderson flicks to long-on
that's a poor ball. Hurls a very quick delivery too far outside off
this was in the slot and Anderson has slog swept him miles over midwicket. Tambe bowls the wrong 'un, but he's overpitched
this was on leg stump, and Anderson has shoveled it wide of midwicket's reach. Good effort from the fielder there, but in vain
pushes the good length ball that skids off the pitch and doesn't turn. Anderson goes for the cut and missed
flighted on off stump, Rohit has lashed it to long-off
swings and misses, as has been the bane of Anderson this IPL. Another slower ball and it holds in the pitch just enough to hurt Mumbai
waits on the change of pace and works it behind square leg for a single
pulled, but only as far as long-on. Anderson is really trying to hit the ball hard but he's not timing it at all now
how did that miss off stump? He's rooted to the crease and swings off his hips, the slower, good length ball misses its target by a whisker
goes full and a touch outside off, Rohit works it down to wide long-on
full on the pads, Anderson looks to flick it away but gets struck on the boot
seeks the block hole just outside off, carved to extra cover for a quick single
just back of a length, slower ball again. Rohit tucks it to midwicket for a single
this has been smoked over point! Lands in the second tier, that is Rohit at his very best. It was short and he rode the bounce with aplomb
slower ball, think it was the legcutter. Anderson chops it through to the covers
shortish and outside off, tapped behind point for a quick single
fullish and outside off, driven to mid-off

he's broken Mumbai! This was another slower ball and Pollard after having walked down the pitch, his flick ends up looping it to square leg. Hit too high on the bat as he was closing the face. Hodge runs in and picks up the simplest catch.
that's outta here! It was length and allowed Pollard to free his arms. Slogged over cow corner!
dupes Anderson with a change of pace. It was shortish and he had set up for the pull, but it sits in the deck and after he was done with the shot, he is hit on the back. Single taken
shortish and outside off, Pollard walks down and taps it into the point region for a single
goes full, goes straight and it's timber! Cooper punches his chest and then the air after he deceived Huss who was looking to hack it through the leg side but the shot across the line doesn't succeed
gets a little more lift courtesy those strong shoulders. Huss was down the track again, but is beaten as he looks to launch
chipped it over mid-off and extra cover. That was so wonderfully played from Hussey to collect three runs
shortish and has enough width for Huss to tap it through to the sweeper to bring up the second fastest fifty of the season
it's a full toss outside off, Huss dancing down has made Kulkarni change tactics but he toes the wrong side of the white line
switches around the wicket but that doesn't perturb Huss who dances down and flicks it over square leg. Carried just over the rope.
full and a touch wide of off stump, he cleared his front leg to launch it over the off side but gets an inside edge. Quick single to midwicket
goes again, but this time he toe-ends it back to the bowler. Dhawal gets the ball and feigns a throw. Stares him down like a big tall fast bowler
another length ball, this time Anderson steps forward and launches it into the sight screen. Go big or go home seems to be the philosophy today
switches around the wicket and goes full on off stump. Huss presents a lovely cover drive but can't beat the off side infield
runs down the pitch and gets a thick outside edge that carries fine enough to the third man boundary. He was looking over point with the room he made, but he'll take it nonetheless
this is a top edge and it was in the air for ages. Anderson was stuck on the back foot and was hurried into a pull. But long-on is back and midwicket cannot get across quick enough
charges out but Watson ups his pace and pushes a fuller ball beyond Anderson's reach as he made room outside leg
this time it is length and Anderson has pulled it clean over deep midwicket. Two balls, two thumping hits. Mumbai are fighting big time here
four off his first ball. Struck very nicely, but he did have some help. Gentle medium pace ends up being too full on off stump. Anderson stands and drills it through extra cover
a touch slower on and around off stump, Hussey eases it in front of point but the slower pace keeps it inside the circle
first strike for Royals, Simmons makes room and slogs a length delivery, it is another slower one, and Faulkner takes a simple catch at mid on
a slow length ball outside off, Simmons' cut finds backward point, he had the width there
eases forward to a length ball and drives to mid off for a quick single
just short of a length, cramping him with the line on the stumps, Hussey tries to whip it to leg, cannot time it, the ball runs down the pitch
Hussey goes maximum first ball, Kulkarni starts shortish, and Hussey hammers it from outside off way over the deep midwicket boundary
third boundary of the over, Faulkner goes short, into the body, Simmons swivels and hooks it just over a jumping short fine leg
denies him width on this back of a length ball, Simmons gets on his toes and pushes to extra cover
four more, it pitches around good length and moves into the pad, Simmons goes back and tucks it past short fine leg
short of a length, he hops and pushes it to covers
this is full outside off, and Simmons has flayed it in the air through extra cover
short and wide, going across, he tries to cut, but misses
